title: ✨ Sometimes the greatest breakthroughs come not from control — but from surrender.
paragraphs:
✨ Sometimes the greatest breakthroughs come not from control — but from surrender.
You’ve strategized, planned, and pushed… but what if God’s plan begins where yours ends?
🎥 This moment is not about losing control — it’s about giving it to the One who knows the way.
🙌 Surrender the strategy. Step into trust. Watch God do more than you ever imagined.
